$comment: The source of sf-progress-run's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js), in the 1.4 form (scripts/generate-component-files.mjs writes rule.js, studio.fixture.json, studio.scenario.json, probe.json and smart.manifest.json from it). A new component, made against standard simai.smart-component 1.3.14 and vocabulary 1.1.5: the run progress the Larena admin screens asked for first (Federation bus msg-993e1e39151942c19b23 item 6), planned in the reply msg-05e76ea0bc0746a690b8 as sf-progress-run of block progress.

look.summary: The look (owner decision C34): full -- the card: title with the state badge, the overall bar with «N из M · %» and the time left, the counts, the first errors, the steps with a log each, the actions; it is also the summary once the job ended. compact -- one line for a table row: a thin bar with «62 % · 3 мин» while it runs, the state badge once it stopped, icon actions. notice -- one row for a corner panel: the ring in the icon field, the name, a line of figures and Expand. The data are the same in every look; the host changes look (minimize, expand). Named look, not view: view is a name the element runtime keeps for itself

label.summary: The job's name as a person says it («Импорт товаров из «Прайс_ноябрь.xlsx»»): the title (a heading of heading-level) and the region's name. Without it the region is named «Ход выполнения» / «Progress» and the full look has no title line

heading-level.summary: The title's heading level in the page outline (h1-h6), 3 by default. Semantics only: the title is drawn at the run's rung text line, semibold, whatever the level (C34, R082), so it follows density and the phone ladder

caption.summary: A line under the title: where and when («Каталог «Электроника» · запущено в 14:02»). Plain text

value.summary: How much is done, in units of total (4812). With total the overall bar is determinate and the figures read «4 812 из 12 000 товаров · 40 %»; without total the bar runs (indeterminate) and the figure reads the count so far

total.summary: How much there is (12000). Unset or 0: the size is not known yet and the bar runs; once set the same bar fills, once (C34)

unit.summary: The word of the figures, its plural forms separated by | in the order of the page language's plural categories (ru: «товар|товара|товаров», en: «item|items»); one form is used for all

remaining.summary: The time left in milliseconds, when the host knows it. Without it the run works it out from the rate of value, hidden until the rate settles (5 s of change) and always rounded up («осталось ≈ 6 мин», «меньше минуты»)

started-at.summary: When the job started (ISO 8601): the elapsed time while the size is unknown, and «заняло 8:08» once it ended. Without it the run counts from the moment it first saw the job run

finished-at.summary: When the job ended (ISO 8601), for a summary a server prints: «заняло» is finished-at − started-at

steps.summary: The job's steps in order, each {id, title, state waiting|running|done|failed|skipped, text?, value?, total?, unit?, log?, started?, finished?, duration?}. A property, or the JSON island a server prints; the host sets the whole list again or changes one step with the action step. Time per step: duration in milliseconds, else finished − started (ISO 8601), and a running step with started counts up each second. An unknown state reads as waiting. value and total give a step its own figures («18 240 из 42 600 файлов»), written before its text; log is the step's own log so far as plain text (a server prints it), and chunk({text, step}) appends to it

run-state.summary: The job's state (the name state is the element base's own). auto works it out from the steps: failed when one failed, running while one runs, done when every step is done or skipped (partial when errors-total or an error counter is above 0), else waiting (drawn as queued). paused: the host stopped the job and will go on -- a warning badge and bar. partial: it finished with errors -- a warning badge and bar, never success. cancelled: the host stopped it for good -- neutral

result-text.summary: The result in words once the job ended: «Сайт создан» on success, the reason on a failure («Не хватает места на диске»), what to do on partial. Without it the result says «Готово», «Готово с ошибками», «Не удалось» or «Отменено»

counters.summary: The result counts as one line of text in tabular figures: «Добавлено 9 227 · Обновлено 2 755 · 18 ошибок». Each {id, label, value, status?, zero?}: the label followed by the value, or with {n} where the number stands; plural forms separated by | («{n} ошибка|{n} ошибки|{n} ошибок»). A counter at 0 is left out; a status error counter at 0 shows its zero words (zero, «ошибок нет») in the quiet colour once the job ended. Only a non-zero error count is coloured, and it is a link that sends report

errors.summary: The first errors of the job, each {where?, key?, text}: where it happened (a row «218»), what (an article «TV-55-QL»), and why. The first 5 are shown in the summary; errors-total says how many there are

errors-total.summary: How many errors the job had in all (40). Above the errors shown, «Ещё 35 ошибок» sends report; above 0 an auto run that finished is partial

output.summary: The output so far, as plain text (a server prints it); the action chunk appends to it. Drawn monospace, never as markup

output-label.summary: The output pane's toggle; «Вывод» / «Output» when not set

file-name.summary: The name the output is saved under by the download button

cancelable.summary: Shows Cancel while the job runs; its press asks cancel

pausable.summary: Shows Pause while the job runs and Continue while it is paused; their presses send pause and resume. Only where the host can really pause the job (C34)

retryable.summary: Shows Retry after a failure, a cancel or a partial result; its press sends retry {scope, from?}: «Повторить неудачные» (scope failed) on partial, «Повторить» (scope all, from the failed step) on a failure

hideable.summary: Shows Hide once the job ended; its press asks close

minimizable.summary: Shows Minimize in the full look; its press sends minimize, and the host shows the notice look (a corner panel is the page's composition)

size.summary: The ladder rung: a step's title is the rung's line, its text, time and the output the rung below's, a one-line step the rung's control height. 1/2 for a narrow drawer

output-open.summary: The output pane is open. A person opens and closes it with its toggle; a page may open it (a failure, say). The pane follows the newest line only while the reader is at its end

cancel.summary: A person pressed Cancel while the job ran (vocabulary §5 cancel). A request: the host stops the job and sets state cancelled (or the failed step); the component changes nothing by itself

retry.summary: A person pressed Retry (vocabulary §5 retry): {scope: failed} after a partial result -- only what failed; {scope: all, from?} after a failure (from: the failed step's id) or a cancel. The host starts the job again and sets the steps anew

close.summary: A person pressed Hide once the job ended (vocabulary §5 close). A request: not cancelled, the host removes the run or closes the drawer it stands in; the component does not hide itself

download.summary: A person pressed the download button of the output (vocabulary §5 download). Not cancelled, the browser saves the output as plain text under file-name; a page that keeps the full log cancels it and serves its own file

toggle.summary: The output pane was opened or closed by its toggle: the fact after the change, {open}

pause.summary: A person pressed Pause while the job ran (pausable). A request: the host pauses the job and sets run-state paused; the component changes nothing by itself

resume.summary: A person pressed Continue while the job was paused (pausable). A request: the host goes on and sets run-state running

minimize.summary: A person pressed Minimize in the full look (minimizable). A request: the host shows the notice look, in its own corner panel

expand.summary: A person pressed Expand in the notice look. A request: the host shows the full look (in a drawer or in place)

report.summary: A person asked for the errors: the error count link or «Ещё N ошибок». Not cancelled, the count link moves to the error list shown in the summary; the host serves the full report (a file, a page)

chunk.summary: Appends text to the output: chunk({text, step?}), the object form of vocabulary §5.2 chunk {id, text} of a stream (a rule hands a job's output chunk on); a plain string, chunk(text), is accepted as shorthand. With step the text goes to that step's own log (its row opens it; a failed step's log is open by itself); without step to the run's output. A line break ends a line; the pane follows the new text only while the reader is at its end. Refused {reason: invalid} for no text, {reason: missing} for a step the run does not have

clear.summary: Empties the output (a job started again)

step.summary: Changes one step: the fields given replace that step's (state, text, value, total, started, finished, duration). Refused {reason: missing} for an id the run does not have

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16).

accessibility.$comment: A region named by its label (a group in the compact look, a row of the notice panel). The title is a heading of heading-level. The steps are an ordered list; each says its state in words after its title (visually hidden; the icon is a picture), the running one carries aria-current step; a step with a log is a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls. One status live region, visually hidden, speaks the result and the state changes only (paused, going on, finished, cancelled), never each percent; the figures are not live. The overall bar is sf-progress-bar named by the label, indeterminate while the size is unknown, its value text saying paused. The error count is a link to the error list. The output toggle is a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls; the output is a log region (role log, not live) that is focusable to scroll by keyboard. Nothing takes focus by itself.

x-summary: A long job as a person sees it, in one of three looks (C34): full -- title and state badge, the overall bar with «N из M · %» and the time left, the counts as one line, the first errors, the steps with states, times and a log each, Pause/Continue, Cancel, Minimize, and once ended the summary with Retry and Hide; compact -- a table row's bar or badge; notice -- a corner panel's row. The host drives it; it polls nothing.

x-source.brief: Federation bus msg-993e1e39151942c19b23 item 6 from the Larena storage thread (owner-approved panel prototype, 2026-11-02; first in their order of value): a vertical list of steps with states (waiting / running / done / failed / skipped) and time per step, a collapsible output pane (monospace, append API, follows the tail only when the reader is at the bottom, copy and download), then the result (success / failure with reason), plus actions (cancel while running, retry after failure, hide). The host drives it through settings or methods; no polling of its own. Used for any plan → confirm → job flow: create site, update, backup and restore, import, publish, package install. Larena composes it with sf-drawer and sf-confirm-change into one change sheet.

x-decisions: name: sf-progress-run, a variant of block progress (ui-control control/decisions/2026-11-02-smart-component-naming.md: sf-<block>-<variant>; the reply msg-05e76ea0). sf-progress-bar and sf-progress-ring show one value; the run shows a job of steps, so it is a component of its own in the family. sf-steps is the wizard's stepper of places a person moves through; the run's steps are what a machine does, with times and an output, so the run draws its own list with sf-steps' state glyphs (check_circle, error, do_not_disturb_on, progress_activity turning).

states: a step is waiting, running, done, failed or skipped (the owner's words in the brief); the job (run-state; state is the element base's own name) is auto (worked out: failed when a step failed, running while one runs, done when every step is done or skipped, else waiting) or the host's running, done, failed, cancelled. The job's state is the host state data-state.

time: a step's duration in milliseconds, else finished − started; a running step with started counts up once a second (one timer per run, only while a step runs and the element is connected). Written m:ss, h:mm:ss over an hour, in tabular figures.

output: plain text, never markup: the setting output and the action chunk {text} (vocabulary §5.2: a job's output chunk is handed on by a rule), clear empties it. The pane is a pre in a scroller of role log (not live), focusable to scroll by keyboard; it follows the newest text only while the reader is at its end, by core's reading position (core/js/reading-position.js atEnd before a write, toEnd after), so a reader scrolled up keeps their place. Copy is sf-button-copy with the pane as its target; download sends the cancelable download and, not cancelled, saves the text as file-name (a Blob, text/plain).

result: once the job ended, a line with the status icon and result-text (or «Готово», «Не удалось», «Отменено»), in a status live region so it is read when the job ends; the steps are not live, so a job of many steps does not talk.

actions: Cancel while running (cancelable) asks cancel, a request the host answers by stopping the job and setting state; Retry after a failure or a cancel (retryable) sends retry; Hide once ended (hideable) asks close {reason: close}, and the host removes the run or closes its drawer. The component does none of them itself and polls nothing (owner brief: the host drives it).

a11y: a region named by label; the steps an ordered list, each saying its state in words after its title, the running one aria-current step. The output toggle has aria-expanded and aria-controls. Nothing takes focus by itself.

geometry: one rung S (size 1/2 or 1): a step's title is the rung's line and type, its text and time the rung below's, the state icon the title's line, icon-to-text the rung's text-space-x, a step's block inset (H − L) / 2 so a one-line step is the rung's control height H; the output monospace in the rung below's type and line, its inset the rung below's space-x; the buttons sf-button of the rung below. Lines and the pane at the rung's inline inset (0 by default: the run stands in a drawer that has its own).

css-variables: six public variables (§6) -- the run's fill (none by default), the dividers, the output's fill and ink, the output's greatest height and the inline inset -- listed in src/core/contracts/public-variables.v1.json; the Framework never sets one.

version 1.0.1 (2026-11-08): a patch, nothing drawn differently by this element. Its first-paint sheet list names the kbd sheet (component.kbd 1.1.0, docs review R030): sf-button 1.8.0 draws a shortcut's keys with it, and every component that draws an sf-button asks for it before the first paint. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.2.0 (one number above the unreleased 1.0.2 and 1.1.0 it joins): the sf-button and sf-button-icon it draws are asked for their current names (appearance ghost for link, status danger for error; actions block, decisions C13 and C15), so the template uses no dated alias; nothing it draws changes.

version 1.2.0 background-color-names: the public variables --sf-progress-run-background-color, --sf-progress-run-output-background-color (C16 naming: a variable that sets a colour ends in -color, as the other 53 do). The former names --sf-progress-run-background, --sf-progress-run-output-background are still read under the new one until 2027-01-01 (change journal token-component-background-color-names, src/core/contracts/token-aliases.v1.json); nothing draws differently.

version 1.2.1 (2026-11-09): a patch, nothing drawn or done differently. The chunk method is declared in its canonical object form, chunk({text}) (an object, so a stream fact can grow fields), where the generated reference read chunk(text); a plain string stays accepted as shorthand, as the element always did. The step method too: step({id, state, text, started, finished, duration}) (one object; the positional call would write the fields it was not given as empty), generated now that the generator writes every action in its object form (x-registry.action-calls keeps chunk's string). Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.2.2 (2026-11-09): a patch, nothing drawn differently. step(id, state) called positionally changes only the fields given (core.runtime 1.43.0 names only the parameters a positional call gives; it wrote text, started, finished and duration as undefined). A change made before the run first read the host's list is kept: the list is taken up when step runs, not at the next read, which cleared it. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.3.0 (owner decision C34, 2026-11-10; research ui-control control/research/2026-11-09-progress-run.md, prototype prototypes/progress-run.html, remarks R045, R073, R082, R086): a minor -- settings, events and an action field added, every 1.2 setting, event, action and class name kept. look full|compact|notice (named look and started-at/finished-at: view and started are names the element runtime reserves, and a reserved setting is refused without a word) (the summary is full once ended). value/total/unit on the run and on each step: the overall bar (sf-progress-bar 1.3.0: indeterminate without total, once determinate never back) and «N из M unit · P %» (the percentage floored, so 100 % only at the end; the unit's plural form by Intl.PluralRules of the page language). The time left: the host's remaining, else (total − value) / rate over the last 30 s, shown once the rate settled (5 s of change) and always rounded up (minutes up, «меньше минуты» under 60 s); paused freezes nothing it does not know -- the estimate starts afresh after resume. The elapsed time while the size is unknown, «заняло» once ended (started-at/finished-at, else the moments the run saw). run-state adds paused (warning badge sf-badge activity paused, warning bar) and partial (finished with errors: warning badge «С ошибками» with the warning icon and a warning bar, never success); cancelled is neutral (badge activity stopped with «Отменено», the bar's neutral status: sf-progress-bar has no grey status, and none is added -- open question of C34 answered with neutral); a waiting run shows the queued badge. counters as one text line in tabular figures, zero counters left out, only a non-zero error count coloured and a link that sends report; errors: the first 5 with where/key/text, errors-total, «Ещё N ошибок» sends report. retry {scope: all|failed, from?}. chunk({text, step}) writes a step's own log (its row a toggle, a failed step's log open by itself). pausable (pause/resume requests), minimizable (minimize request), expand from the notice look. Layout by groups with system spacing (R073): head (title and caption touching, the badge on the first title line), progress (bar to figures --sf-progress-run-gap-tight = --sf-space-1/3), results (result to counts --sf-space-1/4), errors, steps (a divider opens them when a group stands above), output, actions; between groups --sf-progress-run-gap = --sf-space-1 (16 desktop, 12 phone and compact). The title: heading-level (default 3) for the outline, drawn at the rung's text line semibold (--sf-text-size-1 / --sf-text-height-1 at size 1: 16/24 desktop, 14/20 phone and compact; R082, decision row C34 -- not the page heading step of C21); file names wrap whole (overflow-wrap normal). Inner buttons and badges take the rung below the run's own size, marked relative, so density (C22) reaches them. The notice ring stands in the icon field of the rung (line − 2 × 2 px: 20 desktop, 16 phone; R086) through the ring's internal step size: sf-progress-ring has no icon-field step yet (named follow-up). Screen readers hear the result and the state changes only, from one visually hidden status region; the old visible status line is the visible result only.

version 1.3.1 (2026-11-10, C34 acceptance D1, D4): a patch, no setting, event or action added. Focus stays on the run's buttons when the run swaps them (WCAG 2.4.3): a press the host answers by a new run-state or look replaced the pressed button, and focus fell to the page, so a second Space on Pause did nothing and Enter after Minimize could not expand. The button that took its place now has focus (Pause and Continue, Minimize and Expand; Cancel to Retry or Hide), else the next one the run still shows; a focus outside the run is never taken. A run of unknown size with no count shows no count (the absent value read 0 and drew a bare «0»). The running examples start when the page loads (no fixed past started-at). In compact density the result line is regular weight, so only the title is bold (owner's C34 amendment, R082).

version 1.3.2 (2026-11-10, pair-next candidate sweep): a patch, nothing drawn or done differently. The template context carried the state's badge and bar under the key look, the name of the look setting, so the context said {activity, bar} where the setting says full (manifest-defaults and template-context probes). It is stateLook now; the look setting keeps its manifest default full and its getter.

version 1.3.2 also carries the C16 leftovers (2026-11-10, not yet released, so no second number): nothing draws differently. Its sheet reads the C16 role name --sf-surface-area where it read the former --sf-surface-1 (an alias of it until 2027-01-01, token-c16-theme-role-names), so a page that sets the new name reaches it; the value is the same in both themes and on every place. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged. (the output's fill, twice)

version 1.3.3 (2026-11-10, fix/backgrounds-c41-c42): the leftovers of fix/c16-c20-leftovers (91c85885) landed on top of the number that pair ui-2bd5a3ab478a already shipped, so they take the next number; no other change.

forbidden_client_responsibilities: polling the job (the host sets the steps and appends the output)
running, cancelling or retrying the job (the host answers cancel and retry)
deciding that a job ended (the host sets the steps or state)

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-progress-run for a long job a person started and waits for: creating a site, an update, a backup or a restore, an import, a publish, a package install.
do_not: Do not poll from the component; the host sets the steps and appends the output with chunk
Do not use it for one value of progress; sf-progress-bar does that
Do not render markup in the output; it is plain text
ai_guidance.minimal_example: <sf-progress-run label="Импорт товаров" total="12000" value="4812" unit="товар|товара|товаров" pausable cancelable></sf-progress-run>

keyboard: Tab reaches the error link, the step logs, the output toggle, the output, copy, download and the actions in order
Enter or Space presses a button; Enter follows the error link
accessibility.focus: The run never takes focus by itself.
